title: Divers Found a 2,000-Year-Old Computer Made of Gears

scenes.text: Divers found a 2,000-year-old computer made of gears.
In 1900, sponge divers found a shipwreck near the Greek island of Antikythera.
Inside, a corroded lump broke apart and revealed bronze gears.
It has dozens of tiny gears and tracked the Moon and the Sun.
Experts call it the most sophisticated device found from ancient and medieval times.

description:
Divers found a 2,000-year-old computer made of gears.
The Antikythera mechanism was recovered from a shipwreck in 1900. Its bronze gears modelled the Moon and the Sun and predicted eclipses.
What ancient invention amazes you most? Comment below.
first_comment: Nobody knows who built it. Who do you think did?
